crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…
But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not…
Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors…
For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.
I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…
Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us…
“Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth…
Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and…
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…
who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still…
But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the…
And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory…
Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.
I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for…
I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will…
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.
Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

translations.web: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
translations.bsb: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
translations.kjv: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
translations.asv: Hide not thy face from me; Put not thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
